options.opd: They are very active against extracellular bacteria.

analysis: Th1 lymphocytes are primarily involved in cell-mediated immunity and are known for producing interferon gamma (IFN-γ), which activates macrophages and enhances the immune response against intracellular pathogens. They do not mediate allergic diseases, activate mast cells, or primarily target extracellular bacteria. While they can recruit neutrophils, their main function is the production of IFN-γ.
